headline: Leaked images show new Fitbit Edge succeeding the Fitbit Charge line
summary: Leaked images reveal an upcoming Fitbit Edge that appears to replace the Fitbit Charge line, last updated in 2023, featuring a screen and colors resembling the Pixel 11.

claims.statement: Images leaked showing the upcoming Fitbit Edge.

sources.quote: Google's Fitbit Edge leaks out with a screen and Pixel 11 colors

claims.statement: The Fitbit Edge appears to be a successor to the Fitbit Charge line.

sources.quote: it appears to be a successor to the midrange Charge line
looks like a replacement for the Fitbit Charge last seen in 2023

claims.statement: The leaked device shows Pixel 11-style colors and a screen.
